title: Perihelion v1.8.4 theme overhaul, options full-page navigation, and banner styling polish
content:
This update refines Perihelion with unified banner typography, a dedicated full-page options management layout, and theme/wallpaper enhancements.

Key highlights:

  • Banner and typography alignment: Synchronized top and bottom banner font styles, line heights, and hover behaviors to match Lionship and Auth, with purple (#de8bf7) hover accents and exact copyright styling.
  • Dedicated options page & auth flow: Converted options into a dedicated full-page view for tags and lists, routed account links to new tabs, and streamlined auth verification for instant single-click navigation.
  • Dark mode & camera pattern wallpaper: Added full light/dark theme adaptation with subtle background tinting, dark mode local folder dialogs, and bold blue indicators for Max Mode thumbnail controls (100px / 100 limit).
